# sigma_workspaces (Data Source)

Lists Sigma workspaces using the paginated v2.1 endpoint. Results preserve Sigma API order; key collections by returned IDs rather than positional indices. Pagination cursors and page sizes are not exposed; this data source retrieves every page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_workspaces" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `exact_name` (String) Exact name filter (`exactName`).
- `name` (String) Partial name filter (`name`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identifier for this data source.
- `workspaces` (Attributes List) Workspaces in API order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--workspaces))

<a id="nestedatt--workspaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `workspaces`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Workspace creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) ID of the member who created the workspace.
- `id` (String) Workspace ID.
- `name` (String) Workspace name.
- `updated_at` (String) Workspace update timestamp.
- `updated_by` (String) ID of the member who last updated the workspace.
- `url_id` (String) Base62 identifier used in Sigma workspace URLs.
